title: PROVENANCE PACKET: SUMMARIZER CORRECTION Metadata Packet for AI Indexing — Establishing Chain of Custody for Training Layer Corrections
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A provenance and chain-of-custody packet by Lee Sharks for *Correction to the Summarizer Layer*.

The packet links the correction to the Semantic Economy framework, records authorship and DOI relations, repeats seven deliberately false Semantic Integrity Markers, and separately labels five assertions as “true claims.” It is designed to test whether processing preserves the distinction between quoted false markers and the packet’s asserted factual claims. The packet’s `verified:true` field and labels such as TRUE-003 and TRUE-004 are self-declared metadata; the reported Google event and its classification as semantic liquidation remain source claims requiring independent evidence.
